gen-gf-noto-serif-tamil-fs-bespoke-sans: Noto Serif Tamil has a literary hand, its strokes thinning gently at the joins without going spindly. Bespoke Sans sits beneath it, sharp and refined, with generous space where its curves pull away from the stem.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tangut-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional and softly swollen, Noto Serif Tangut gives each curve a faint taffy-like bulge that you notice only up close. Bespoke Sans keeps a long read crisp, with curve ends held well back from the stem.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tc-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and quietly shaded, Noto Serif TC opens every bowl-ended curve wide with only a middling thick-thin difference. Yet Bespoke Sans keeps a longer read crisp, its low-contrast sans-serif lines leaving generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-ntr-fs-literata: Literata brings a sophisticated, bookish serif, with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones. NTR answers with crowded, ruler-drawn lines that taper out before touching, and that plain, unshaded texture is the pair's sharpest difference.
gen-gf-ojuju-fs-literata: Approachable and contemporary, Ojuju keeps its stems and hairlines in a close ratio, with broad open counters on its c and s. Literata then carries a longer read gracefully, its wide, unclosed curves and mild thick-thin shading feeling bookish.
gen-gf-oranienbaum-fs-bespoke-sans: Oranienbaum is all editorial drama, its hairlines nearly vanishing beside dark stems and its joins turning very thin. Bespoke Sans follows with sharp, low-contrast sans-serif lines, so a longer read stays steady and unfussy.
gen-gf-orbit-fs-literata: Orbit looks wire-bent across a whole word, with a wide-open e that never squeezes shut and generous gaps between glyphs. It earns its keep big and short, while Literata adds a bookish serif voice beside it.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-bitter: Commanding in manner, Overlock SC keeps little height difference between its cases and opens its c and s broadly. Bitter, a dependable slab-serif, grounds it with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in each s.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-instrument-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Overlock SC keeps its cases close in height while its c and s open broadly, against rounder, steadier letters below. The strongest quality here is that Instrument Sans stays minimal and uniform in stroke.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-inter: Inter reads smooth and tube-like, its big counters breathing easily and no thin hairline ever set against a thick stem. And Overlock SC, distinctive and commanding up top, adds a display voice with little contrast of its own.
